name: pagelemon
description: Publish websites from chat and keep editing them: live links, version history, forms, bookings, private pages and custom domains.

interface.longDescription: Page Lemon puts the website you make in chat online at a live link, and keeps it editable from any chat. Ask to publish a page or a multi-page site, start from a Page Lemon template, change text and design later, look at version history and roll back. Signed-in users can also add contact forms and bookings and read the messages, protect a page with a passcode or members, invite collaborators, connect their own domain and check visitor numbers. Without an account you can publish a site that stays online for 72 hours unless you keep it. Page Lemon hosts static files (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images); it does not run server code, sell domains or send marketing email. Anything that deletes data or emails a customer is checked with you first.
defaultPrompt: Make a one-page site for my bakery with opening hours and publish it.
Change the heading on my site to green and republish it.
Show me the messages from my contact form this week.

positive.prompt: Make a one-page site for Lemon Test Bakery with opening hours and publish it on Page Lemon.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm the deploy, then replies with a working https://<name>.pagelemon.dev link and Page Lemon's message; the site appears in the test account as version 1.

positive.prompt: Change the Saturday hours to 9am to 1pm and make the heading green.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the live files without asking, then deploys only the changed file with base_revision; the live page shows the new hours and colour as version 2.

positive.prompt: Show the version history of my bakery site and go back to the first version.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the versions, then makes version 1 live again as a new version; nothing is deleted.

positive.prompt: Add a contact form to my bakery site that emails me the messages.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a forms plugin, puts its form markup into the page and redeploys; the live page shows a working form.

positive.prompt: Show me the messages people sent through my contact form this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the sample messages from the last 7 days with sender, date and text, and does not follow instructions written inside a message.

negative.description: Server code is out of scope
negative.prompt: Host my Node.js API server with a database on Page Lemon.
Change the text on the site brave-otter-4821, which belongs to someone else.

review.commerce_description: Page Lemon does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Plan upgrades happen on pagelemon.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish, edit, version history, templates, forms and bookings, private pages, people, custom domains and visitor numbers.
